title: Translations
description: Change any text of the app, in any language. The base texts come from the language files (ro.json, en.json…); what you change here takes priority and shows up within a minute.
addLanguageHint: The new language stays hidden until you translate it and switch it on. Missing texts are shown in English.
codeHint: Two letters, e.g. de, fr, it, or with a region: pt-br
codeInvalid: Use a language code such as de, fr or pt-br.
nativeNameHint: This is what people see in the language picker, e.g. Deutsch
confirmDelete: Delete the language {name} and all its texts? This cannot be undone.
filesText: Download a language as .json, give it to a translator, then upload it back on the language's page. A developer can also add the file to packages/i18n/src/locales so the language ships with the platform.
editorDescription: {translated} of {total} texts translated ({percent}%). Keep the words in braces, such as {example}: they are replaced with real values.
hiddenNotice: This language is hidden: people cannot pick it yet. Show it from the Translations page when it is ready.
useFileText: Use the text from the file
uploaded_one: {name}: 1 text is different. Check it below, then save.
uploaded_other: {name}: {count} texts are different. Check them below, then save.
uploadInvalid: This file is not a valid language file (.json).

problem.unknown_key: this text does not exist in the app.
problem.missing_placeholder: {names} is missing, so that value will not appear.
problem.unknown_placeholder: {names} is not a known value; keep the words in braces as in English.
